<<On Mending Of Fishing Nets This Season>>  

This season, our neighborhood came together to mend fishing nets, a tradition that has been passed down through generations. Volunteers gathered to repair damaged nets, ensuring safe catches for local fishermen. The effort not only helped sustain the community but also fostered a sense of unity. With each stitch and knot, we reminded ourselves of the importance of cooperation and care for our shared resources. Let’s continue to support each other in times of need.
